fields.Name: IT140 - MetadataSync Declared Query Children
fields.Description: Pushes scratch metadata trees through PushService (zzz-it140 prefix) and asserts the MJ: Queries child rows that result. MSQ1 declared Parameters, Fields and Entities collections are stored as declared on a new query and replaced on update. MSQ2 the legacy relatedEntities format is promoted to the declared collections. MSQ3 a query with no declared children gets its rows from extraction, new and on an SQL update. MSQ4 rows declared later replace the extracted rows of the same name, keeping their own IDs. MSQ5 removing a declared parameter from the file removes its row. MSQ6 an unchanged re-push writes no row (snapshots with timestamps compared). MSQ7 pushing a copy of the shipped metadata/queries tree changes no MJ: Queries, Query Fields, Query Parameters, Query Entities or Query Dependencies row. MSQ8 one push creates a reusable query and a query composing it (the composed query is found inside the push transaction, before the query cache hears of it). MSQ9 a declared field carrying only its name and annotations gets its sequence, types and source from extraction. Self-cleaning.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: MetadataSync stores declared query children as declared, falls back to extraction otherwise, and an unchanged push of the shipped queries is a no-op.
